title: list_open_events

token_id.description: Registry token key (reg.tokens), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. bitcoin:BTC in «Bitcoin (BTC) · bitcoin:BTC».

entity_id.description: Registry entity key (reg.entities), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. uniswap in «Uniswap · uniswap».

description: List open events eligible for routing or comparison, including their statements, entities, tokens, current stages, known-to-us time and session associations. Filter by token_id or entity_id (a token's project and a project's tokens match too), or omit both for every open event. Use their recorded evidence to distinguish a new development from a duplicate or continuation; listing an event does not modify it.
